name: Koukan Nikki
source:
Koukan Nikki has a gameplay somewhat similar to Dokyusei. You will be able to meet different females in the town. At the end, you will be with the girl that you liked the most.

[From [url=http://www.densetsu.com/display.php?id=314&style=alphabetical]Anime Densetsu[/url]]
translation:
《交换日记》的玩法与《同级生》有些相似。玩家可以在镇上邂逅不同女性，最终与最喜欢的女孩走到一起。

[译自 [url=http://www.densetsu.com/display.php?id=314&style=alphabetical]Anime Densetsu[/url]]
